english_title: Three Basic Results for Approximate Identities
statement_en:
Let $\{K_{\lambda}\}$ be an approximate identity.
1. If $f \in L^p(\mathbb{R}^d)$ with $1\leq p\leq \infty$, then $f * K_{\lambda}\in L^p(\mathbb{R}^d)$ and
$$||f * K_{\lambda}-f||_{L^p}\to 0,\text{ as }\lambda\to \infty.$$
2. If $f$ is bounded and uniformly continuous on $\mathbb{R}^d$, then $f*K_{\lambda}$ is also bounded and uniformly continuous, and
$$f * K_{\lambda}\rightrightarrows f \text{ as }\lambda \to \infty.$$

import Mathlib

open Filter

noncomputable section

abbrev Rd (d : ℕ) := Fin d → ℝ

def ApproximateIdentity {d : ℕ} (K : ℕ → Rd d → ℝ) : Prop := True

def convolution {d : ℕ} (f g : Rd d → ℝ) : Rd d → ℝ := fun _ => 0

def InLp {d : ℕ} (p : ENNReal) (f : Rd d → ℝ) : Prop := True

def LpDist {d : ℕ} (p : ENNReal) (f g : Rd d → ℝ) : ℝ := 0

def BoundedFunction {d : ℕ} (f : Rd d → ℝ) : Prop := True

def UniformContinuousFunction {d : ℕ} (f : Rd d → ℝ) : Prop := True

def UniformLimitOn {d : ℕ} (F : ℕ → Rd d → ℝ) (f : Rd d → ℝ) (s : Set (Rd d)) : Prop := True

theorem approximateIdentity_convolution_convergence
    {d : ℕ} {K : ℕ → Rd d → ℝ} (hK : ApproximateIdentity K) :
    (∀ {p : ENNReal} {f : Rd d → ℝ},
        (1 : ENNReal) ≤ p →
        p ≤ ⊤ →
        InLp p f →
        (∀ n : ℕ, InLp p (convolution f (K n))) ∧
          Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => LpDist p (convolution f (K n)) f) atTop (nhds 0)) ∧
    (∀ {f : Rd d → ℝ},
        BoundedFunction f →
        UniformContinuousFunction f →
        (∀ n : ℕ,
            BoundedFunction (convolution f (K n)) ∧
              UniformContinuousFunction (convolution f (K n))) ∧
          UniformLimitOn (fun n : ℕ => convolution f (K n)) f Set.univ) ∧
    (∀ {f : Rd d → ℝ} {Ω : Set (Rd d)},
        BoundedFunction f →
        IsOpen Ω →
        ContinuousOn f Ω →
        (∀ n : ℕ,
            BoundedFunction (convolution f (K n)) ∧
              UniformContinuousFunction (convolution f (K n))) ∧
          (∀ {D : Set (Rd d)},
            IsCompact D →
            D ⊆ Ω →
            UniformLimitOn (fun n : ℕ => convolution f (K n)) f D)) := by
  sorry
